title: AXGF 1.1 Schema
description: JSON Schema for the Axiom Genealogy Format v1.1 (draft). A superset of 1.0: every entity valid against axgf-1.0.schema.json is valid here. Attribute schemas carry two annotations validators ignore: x-axgf-class, the sensitive class (SPEC_1.1 §4), and x-axgf-unit.

withheld_classes.description: 1.1: the sensitive classes left out of this bundle when it was written (§4.5).

class_visibility.description: 1.1: per-class visibility for this person; may only tighten the default (§4.4).

position.description: 1.1: the post held, where title is the occupation.

time_of_day.description: Local time as recorded: HH:MM or HH:MM:SS.

language_tag.description: 1.1: a BCP 47 tag with optional script, region and variants; und for undetermined.

currency_code.description: ISO 4217 alphabetic code, current or historic.

claim.description: 1.1: one dated, sourced, confidence-bearing claim (§3). Each attribute constrains value.

artefact.description: 1.1: a reference to a Document holding an artefact (§3.5).
